SELECT SOURCE,[DATE]
FROM(
    SELECT CRM_DATE,
           DEPOSITS_DATE,
           LOANS_DATE,
           GLD_DATE,
           CCD_DATE,
           DID_DATE,
           ATM_DATE,
           TRY_DATE,
           MBK_DATE,
           RIB_DATE,
           BOB_DATE,
           TRU_DATE,
           SEC_DATE,
           SED_DATE,
           DEPOSITS_DATE_P2
    FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
)src
UNPIVOT(
    [DATE] FOR SOURCE IN(

        CRM_DATE,
        DEPOSITS_DATE,
        LOANS_DATE,
        GLD_DATE,
        CCD_DATE,
        DID_DATE,
        ATM_DATE,
        TRY_DATE,
        MBK_DATE,
        RIB_DATE,
        BOB_DATE,
        TRU_DATE,
        SEC_DATE,
        SED_DATE,
        DEPOSITS_DATE_P2
    )
)u;
